#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
root=/mnt/borsuk-header-qualification
mkdir "$root/evidence/green-source-admission"
ev="$root/evidence/green-source-admission"
export AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1 AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=eu-central-1
cd "$root"
(cd source; sha256sum --check ../source-files.sha256) > "$ev/red-source-before.log"
timeout --kill-after=2 30 aws s3 cp s3://borsuk-bench-453182569524-euc1/research/semantic-router/20261011/completed-header-population-qualification-a0001/green-inputs/compare_native_replay.green.rs compare_native_replay.green.rs --only-show-errors
printf "%s  %s\n" 87a4e54aeed45c003153259a25e72201dc8b5b016133453ef934b576cd7c7eac compare_native_replay.green.rs | sha256sum -c -
test "$(stat -c %s compare_native_replay.green.rs)" = 348099
timeout --kill-after=2 30 aws s3 cp s3://borsuk-bench-453182569524-euc1/research/semantic-router/20261011/completed-header-population-qualification-a0001/green-inputs/source-files.green.sha256 source-files.green.sha256 --only-show-errors
printf "%s  %s\n" 838e11125971c70418b59817d43dfc69262331f2ef74e98a866153c508ed46c1 source-files.green.sha256 | sha256sum -c -
test "$(stat -c %s source-files.green.sha256)" = 50571
timeout --kill-after=2 30 aws s3 cp s3://borsuk-bench-453182569524-euc1/research/semantic-router/20261011/completed-header-population-qualification-a0001/green-inputs/native-source.green.json native-source.green.json --only-show-errors
printf "%s  %s\n" 4beb5c5af2f3651a88e981619506e38b4756ca7c8bf67cd62f5533ccbec9cc9f native-source.green.json | sha256sum -c -
test "$(stat -c %s native-source.green.json)" = 50078
cp source-files.sha256 "$ev/source-files.red.sha256"
cp native-source.json "$ev/native-source.red.json"
cp source/crates/borsuk/examples/compare_native_replay.rs "$ev/compare_native_replay.red.rs"
mv compare_native_replay.green.rs source/crates/borsuk/examples/compare_native_replay.rs
mv source-files.green.sha256 source-files.sha256
mv native-source.green.json native-source.json
(cd source; sha256sum --check ../source-files.sha256) > "$ev/green-source-after.log"
cp source-files.sha256 native-source.json "$ev/"
printf "%s\n" 2a7b7dd19eeeb88439f79a73e256eb5c0ad6adaf > "$ev/green-source.commit"
(cd "$ev"; find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum) > "$ev/SHA256SUMS"
for file in "$ev"/*; do timeout --kill-after=2 30 aws s3api put-object --bucket borsuk-bench-453182569524-euc1 --key research/semantic-router/20261011/completed-header-population-qualification-a0001/stages/green-source-admission/"$(basename "$file")" --body "$file" --if-none-match "*" > /dev/null; done
printf "GREEN_SOURCE_AUTHENTICATED\\n"
